//: Typecheck the Flow B compiler (aot/), the asset bakers (assets/), hot reload (hotreload/), the package-root scripts and the runtime (src/). Its .mts files are checked strictly; a .mjs file is read only for the types it exports, unless it opts in with // @ts-check. Node runs the .mts files directly by stripping their types, so only erasable syntax is allowed (no enums, namespaces or parameter properties), a relative import names the real file (./x.mts), and a type-only import is written `import type`. The runtime in src/ is checked the same way. Run with `npm run typecheck`.
